description: A D_PDU whose FSN lies in the gap Equation 3 leaves out of sync is not acknowledged: instead of an ACK-ONLY, this node starts a FULL RESET (issue #49 item c).
note: Link setup as dts-arq/rx-data-acked (Called node). At 61000 the peer's burst holds DATA-ONLY FSN 0 (TX WIN LWE set) with 'ping' and FSN 2 (TX WIN UWE set) with 'pong', each a whole C_PDU; FSN 1 is missing. Both are delivered; RX LWE 1, RX UWE 2. The ACK-ONLY at 83000 has RX LWE 1 and bitmap 01 (FSN 2 received). At 96000 the peer sends a DATA-ONLY with FSN 32769 and no window flag. Test 3 (C-0798) accepts the arc from RX UWE - 32767 = 32771 forward to RX LWE + 32767 = 32768, which leaves out exactly 32769 and 32770 (C-0786): out of sync (C-0802). It is not stored and not acknowledged (C-0779, C-1170): unlike a copy behind RX LWE inside the arc (C-1126), it draws no ACK-ONLY. A FULL RESET starts instead (C-0791, C-0792): FULL RESET CMD, RESET FRAME ID 0, at 151000; dts.reset_wait from 156550 (C-1172); the peer's FULL RESET ACK at 161000 stops it. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its bitmap and a RESET/WIN-RESYNC (type 12) 15 bytes. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12, 11, 10, 1, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000, 33000, 30000, 3000, 36000 ms (K-0080). Transmissions are zero filled: fill is P4-3's.
